label: Aquinas, I q.13 a.7 co. and ad 5: Divine dominion rests on creatures’ real subjection
locator: I q.13 a.7 co. and ad 5
interpretation: The relation is real on the creature's side. On God's side it is a relation of reason. The name can be predicated temporally as creatures come to stand in that relation, with no change to God.
attribution: The passage states that God is really Lord over creatures because their subjection to him is real, which is the premise.
